description.value: Plants in the target area erupt into dense, tangled growth. The area becomes difficult terrain, and movement through it costs 4 feet per foot of distance (double the normal difficult terrain cost). Creatures with a fly speed or climb speed are unaffected. The growth is natural and persists for 8 hours; clearing a 5-foot section takes approximately 10 minutes with cutting tools. Has no effect in areas without plants.
